description: A microphone test that answers the real question — will they hear me? A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

samples.description: A block of decoded mono audio samples, each between -1 and 1. Loudness (RMS), peak and the verdict are judged over the whole block, so send a stretch of speech rather than a single frame; a peak at or above 0.99 counts as clipping.

items.description: One mono PCM sample as a float from -1 to 1, where 1 is full scale.

name: mic_test
title: Mic Test
